column1: If rain is more than 20 mm in a day, do not spray pesticide or foliar fertilizer.
If the maximum temperature is above 35°C for 3 consecutive days, irrigate the crop immediately (preferably early morning or evening).
If heavy rain is forecast for your taluk and the crop is ready, harvest early and store under cover.
If no rain is forecast for the next 10 days during flowering or grain/cob filling, give one protective irrigation.
If heavy rain (more than 30 mm) is forecast for your taluk, clear field drainage channels before the rain arrives to prevent root and rhizome rot.
If strong winds (more than 30 km/h) and rain are forecast, prop up banana plants and postpone urea top-dressing.
If your taluk forecast shows cloudy weather and humidity above 85% for 3 or more days, scout closely for fungal blight in tomato, blast in ragi, and sucking pests in cotton.
Only sow rainfed crops (ragi, sunflower, cotton) after your taluk receives at least 25–30 mm of soaking rain so seeds germinate evenly.
